##Today##

Dry and clear at first tonight with temperature falling below 0°C in places, bringing a risk of frost and ice patches developing. Then cloud cover increases as the wind settles to the southeast, allowing temperatures to recover later in the night. Comments: Risk of frost and ice.

##Tomorrow##

A cold start tomorrow with a risk of frost and ice in places. A dry day ahead with sunny intervals, though getting breezier as the light or moderate southeasterly wind strengthens through the afternoon. Top temperature 10°C. Comments: Risk of frost and ice at first. Strong winds developing.

##Monday, 23 November 2026##

Generally cloudy on Monday with a band of rain arriving later in the evening or overnight. Moderate to fresh easterly winds, veering southeast and gradually freshening, possibly reaching gale force overnight. Top temperature 10°C. Comments: Strong winds developing, with a risk of gale force.

Occasional rain or showers on Tuesday, with a few sunny intervals in between. A strong southeast wind, possibly reaching gale force, then veering southwest and easing, backing easterly later. Top temperature 10°C. Comments: Strong winds, with a risk of gale force. Heavy rain for a time.
